pages.title: Goonch
pages.text: The goonch ($(o)Bagarius bagarius$()), long known as $(o)Bagarius yarrelli$(), is a giant catfish of the fast, rocky rivers of India, Nepal and Bangladesh.$(br2)It has a broad, flat head, a wide mouth full of sharp teeth, a mottled brown body and long trailing tips on its fins, and can reach 2 metres.$(br2)Fatal attacks on people in the Kali River between 1998 and 2007 were blamed on a giant goonch, though this was never proven.
